questions.stem: A 28-year-old woman, G1P1, delivered a healthy baby girl via normal vaginal delivery. She is now 2 weeks postpartum and presents for a follow-up visit. On examination, her uterus is not palpable per abdomen. What best describes the normal puerperium duration and uterine involution weight in this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Puerperium is until 6 weeks postpartum; uterine weight - 300 grams

options.label: B
options.text: Puerperium is until 8 weeks postpartum; uterine weight - 500 grams

options.label: C
options.text: Puerperium is until 9 weeks postpartum; uterine weight - 1000 grams

options.label: D
options.text: Puerperium is until 6 weeks postpartum; uterine weight - 100 grams
